newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eleven wheat ships expected in Rouen by November 7.
newsitem.headline: Eleven wheat ships expected in Rouen by November 7.

text.p: Eleven ships were expected in Rouen by November 7 to load some 165,000 tonnes of soft wheat, port officials said on Tuesday.
One ship was also expected in Rouen by November 7 to load 1,300 tonnes of maize, they said
Destinations for the wheat and the maize were not specified.
In Rouen four ships are currently loading a total of 97,000 tonnes of soft wheat destined for Egypt, Italy, Morocco and Sudan.
